summary: Reconstructed the circle-with-chords figure as TikZ. Version 2 compiles and passed the critic with must_repair=false, checklist_score 1.0, and all five labels (A, B, C, D, O) present. Circle and solid segments AB, AC, CB are solid; DC and AD are dashed. Version 2 is the best version. Version 1 had the circle and solid segments drawn dashed, which the critic flagged and I repaired.
